name: @shiranami/desktop
description: Shiranami v2 desktop shell (Tauri) — the Rust backend lives in src-tauri and crates/*

scripts.e2e:build: pnpm -w run build:packages && pnpm --filter @shiranami/web build && cargo build -p shiranami-desktop --features e2e --bin shiranami-desktop
scripts.test:e2e:build: pnpm run e2e:build && pnpm run test:e2e
